info.title: LoopSquad API
info.description:
HTTP API for LoopSquad: verified watch-for-watch growth for creator communities.

Every response is enveloped:
- success: `{ success: true, data, meta }`
- failure: `{ success: false, error: { code, message }, meta }`

Authenticate with a Firebase ID token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Clients must branch on
`error.code` (see the Error schema), never on `error.message`.

bearerAuth.description: Firebase Authentication ID token. The Worker verifies it against Google's public keys and derives the member from it.

ErrorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error codes. Branch on these, never on messages.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: The presented credential is not valid for this request.

AUTH_REQUIRED.description: A Firebase ID token is required (or it expired).

FORBIDDEN.description: The authenticated member is not allowed to perform this action.

SUBMISSION_COOLDOWN.description: The member submitted a video too recently (one per cooldown window).

RATIO_GATE.description: The member's give/take ratio is below the minimum required to submit.

CHANNEL_CONFLICT.description: This YouTube channel is already linked to another account.

AI_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: The AI coach is not configured on this deployment.

NOT_FOUND.description: The requested resource does not exist (or is not visible to this member).

CONFLICT.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.description: The member does not have enough credits for this purchase.

DAILY_LIMIT.description: A per-day allowance (e.g. claimable watches) is exhausted.

RATE_LIMITED.description: Too many requests from this client in the current window.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.description: A member- or platform-level quota (e.g. AI messages) is exhausted.

INTERNAL_ERROR.description: An unexpected server error. Safe to retry with backoff.

DATABASE_ERROR.description: The database operation failed. Safe to retry with backoff.

AI_UNAVAILABLE.description: The AI provider is not configured or is failing.

MISSING_ENV.description: The deployment is missing a required binding or secret.

SCHEMA_OUT_OF_DATE.description: Migrations have not been applied yet; the service is being updated.
